metadata.description:
There is a long pending demand of Ho tribe in Odisha, Jharkhand, West Bengal and Assam to include their language in the 8th schedule of the Indian constitution. The leaders and activists associated with this demand claim that more than 35 Lakh tribal people speak the language in at least four states of the country. These activists say that because Ho is a tribal language, it is being discriminated against, and not being given official status.
